svg.text: End-to-end token and API cost reduction across Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI

g.text: tokscope — Empirical Corpus Overview (315 Claude Code Sessions · 13,370 API Turns · 2.59B Tokens)
Audits instruction files, skill YAML metadata, and MCP tool schemas so you don't
re-pay for 6,000+ idle tokens across 50+ turns.
Idle Prefix Tokens per Turn (50-Turn Session Impact)
✓ Saves 320,550 raw context tokens per 50-turn session with zero quality risk
READ LAYER (64% OF TOOL TOKENS) · OUTLINE IN RUST
Extracts [Lstart-Lend] symbol signatures, reads single functions on demand, and
resolves search hits directly to their enclosing symbol.
Code Exploration & Edit Token Cost (6-File Benchmark, 55.9k tok)
✓ Cuts corpus-wide read exposure by −47.2% (−118.1M re-sent context tokens)
OBSERVATION LAYER · SQUEEZE IN RUST & PRETOOLUSE HOOKS
Strips ANSI spinners & passing tests, keeps 100% of errors/warnings, spills raw log
to .eai/logs/last.log with a 1-line pointer, and halts 3× stuck failure loops.
Test, Build & ANSI Stream Tokens (Pytest + Cargo + Migration Logs)
✓ Avoids the 21,300-token extra recovery turn caused by lossy stdout filters
HISTORY & PROMPT-CACHE LAYER · BATCH OBSERVATION MASKING (H1)
Naive per-turn pruning invalidates the 0.1× prompt cache every turn (+111.8% cost!).
Batch masking compacts only at fixed K=10–15 turn boundaries, keeping prefixes frozen.
Multi-Turn Billed API Cost vs. Baseline (170 Real Sessions, 12,318 Turns)
✓ Beats both No-Masking and LLM Summarization while preserving 98.3% cache hits
